condition_other: Long COVID (post-COVID-19) brain fog with perceptual/cognitive impairment
readout_other: Continuous random dot motion (cRDM) task false-alarm and correct-response rates; brain-fog severity rating scale; resting-state fMRI seed-based functional connectivity from the right inferior insula
direction_notes: Excitatory theta-burst TUS targeting the right inferior insula increased insula-seeded resting-state functional connectivity and significantly reduced the false-alarm rate on the cRDM perceptual task relative to sham (mean change -47.4% vs -23.7%), without a significant immediate change in self-reported brain fog severity.
safety_notes: Acoustic simulations confirmed exposure remained within safety guidelines and thermal simulations verified the maximum target temperature increase did not exceed 2 C; mechanical index was maintained at 0.693 +/- 0.045.

exposures.label: Theta-burst TUS of right inferior insula

target.label: right inferior insula (inferior circular sulcus, Destrieux atlas)

timing.protocol_description: Theta-burst TUS consisted of 20 ms pulses within a 200 ms pulse-repetition interval (5 Hz PRF, 10% duty cycle), for a total of 400 cycles (80 s), delivered once to the right inferior insula under MRI/Brainsight neuronavigation guidance. The sham group underwent an identical procedure with no ultrasound output but matched auditory/procedural cues (transducer operational sound via bone-conduction headphones plus a pre-recorded TPO sound).

source_quotes.n_subjects: We recruited 40 community‑dwelling participants with persistent self‑reported brain‑fog symptoms following COVID‑19. Participants were randomly assigned to either the TUS group (n = 20) or the sham group (n = 20), with groups matched on demographics and baseline characteristics (Table 2).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Immediately after this single stimulation, brain fog symptom ratings did not change significantly $( p = 0 . 3 7 2 )$ .

source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.isppa_w_cm2: The free-field spatial peak pulse-average intensity (ISPPA) was maintained at 33.8 W/cm².
